title: Performance Review Summary
prompt:
You are writing a quarterly performance review summary for a software engineer. Based on the following data points, write a 150-word summary:

- Completed 23 tickets (target was 20)
- Fixed 8 critical bugs
- Mentored 2 junior developers
- Code review participation: 85%
- Customer satisfaction score: 4.2/5
- Missed 1 deadline due to scope creep

The summary should be balanced, professional, and highlight both strengths and areas for improvement.
